evidence.title: AI App and Website Builder | Replit

name: Replit
summary: AI app and website builder: describe an idea and Replit Agent builds, deploys and hosts a working app in the browser.
description: Replit is a browser-based software creation platform: describe what you want and the Replit Agent builds, tests and deploys an app or website. It includes a cloud IDE with AI chat, extensions, SSH and version control, plus deployments, custom domains, databases and app storage, a gallery of apps to remix and quickstart guides.
contains: Agent builds and deploys apps and websites from a prompt
cloud IDE with AI chat, extensions, SSH and version control
gallery of 61 apps and templates to remix
